mapper.insert:
SELECT LESSONS_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO LESSONS ( ID, STUDENT_ID, LESSON_AT ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{studentId}, #{lessonAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} )
mapper.select: SELECT L.ID, L.STUDENT_ID AS "studentId", L.LESSON_AT AS "lessonAt", L.STATUS, L.STATUS_MEMO AS "statusMemo", L.CREATED_AT AS "createdAt" FROM LESSONS L INNER JOIN STUDENTS S ON L.STUDENT_ID = S.ID WHERE L.ID = #{id} AND S.INSTRUCTOR_ID = #{instructorId}

SELECT L.ID, L.STUDENT_ID AS "studentId", L.LESSON_AT AS "lessonAt", L.STATUS, L.STATUS_MEMO AS "statusMemo", L.CREATED_AT AS "createdAt", R.ID AS "lessonReportId" FROM LESSONS L INNER JOIN STUDENTS S ON L.STUDENT_ID = S.ID LEFT JOIN LESSON_REPORTS R ON R.LESSON_ID = L.ID WHERE L.STUDENT_ID = #{studentId} AND S.INSTRUCTOR_ID = #{instructorId} ORDER BY L.LESSON_AT ASC, L.ID ASC

SELECT MIN(TRUNC(L.LESSON_AT)) FROM LESSONS L INNER JOIN STUDENTS S ON L.STUDENT_ID = S.ID WHERE S.INSTRUCTOR_ID = #{instructorId} AND L.LESSON_AT >= #{todayStart, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND L.STATUS = 'SCHEDULED'

SELECT L.ID, L.STUDENT_ID AS "studentId", S.NAME AS "studentName", L.LESSON_AT AS "lessonAt", L.STATUS, R.ID AS "lessonReportId" FROM LESSONS L INNER JOIN STUDENTS S ON L.STUDENT_ID = S.ID LEFT JOIN LESSON_REPORTS R ON R.LESSON_ID = L.ID WHERE S.INSTRUCTOR_ID = #{instructorId} AND L.LESSON_AT >= #{dayStart, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND L.LESSON_AT < #{nextDayStart, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} ORDER BY L.LESSON_AT ASC, L.ID ASC

SELECT L.ID, L.STUDENT_ID AS "studentId", S.NAME AS "studentName", L.LESSON_AT AS "lessonAt", L.STATUS, R.ID AS "lessonReportId" FROM LESSONS L INNER JOIN STUDENTS S ON L.STUDENT_ID = S.ID LEFT JOIN LESSON_REPORTS R ON R.LESSON_ID = L.ID WHERE S.INSTRUCTOR_ID = #{instructorId} AND L.STATUS IN ('ATTENDED', 'LATE') AND R.ID IS NULL ORDER BY L.LESSON_AT ASC, L.ID ASC

SELECT PREVIOUS_LESSON.ID, PREVIOUS_LESSON.STUDENT_ID AS "studentId", PREVIOUS_LESSON.LESSON_AT AS "lessonAt", PREVIOUS_LESSON.STATUS, PREVIOUS_LESSON.STATUS_MEMO AS "statusMemo", PREVIOUS_LESSON.CREATED_AT AS "createdAt" FROM LESSONS CURRENT_LESSON INNER JOIN STUDENTS S ON CURRENT_LESSON.STUDENT_ID = S.ID INNER JOIN LESSONS PREVIOUS_LESSON ON PREVIOUS_LESSON.STUDENT_ID = CURRENT_LESSON.STUDENT_ID WHERE CURRENT_LESSON.ID = #{lessonId} AND S.INSTRUCTOR_ID = #{instructorId} AND PREVIOUS_LESSON.STATUS IN ('ATTENDED', 'LATE') AND PREVIOUS_LESSON.LESSON_AT < CURRENT_LESSON.LESSON_AT ORDER BY PREVIOUS_LESSON.LESSON_AT DESC, PREVIOUS_LESSON.ID DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
